title: BYD Dolphin Essential $28,888 Driveaway @ BYD
body:
Deal: BYD Dolphin Essential $28,888 Driveaway @ BYD

[PinzVidz] Toyota's dream market share coming to a close.
[PinzVidz] And to think it was ½ that price just two generations back.
[2jzzzz] Yep, I bought a Brand new Yaris in 2012 for $16000. Loved that thing
[mikuno] My 2020/21 Yaris was ~18k, the pricing now is just ridiculous.
[Mokr] Does it have hybrid, sensors, abs, ancap, adfas, cruise control, min wage $31,536.96 for that period. Now it's 50k
[Headless] @Mokr: Thanks Government for making all that mandatory
[incipient] I mean that's definitely the play here. These companies aren't cutting prices because they love the consumer - they're buying market share and displacing as many competitors as possible.
[PVA] They are also fighting all the ev cars that ate around too .. lots of competition for all makers now, borh new and old.
[Speedz] Sounds like good competition. Back in the ICE days I didn't have much of a choice, now is a buffet of choice in the pov price bracket.
[ProlapsedHeinous] its a race to the bottom. gonna be really interesting to see which legacy auto makers manage to weather the onslaught.
[Derek Unbelievable] It may be true. But the key point is this is what the price should be, or even less. The RRP in China for these cars are even a fraction of this amazing price.
[donman92] "Improvise, adapt, overcome"
.."so I didn't listen and wondered why I've lost customers" - Toyota probably.
[John Doh] I dont know about that but the wait for a new Rav 4 is still several months and the resale value is crazy - like iPhones.
[donman92] I'd rather an Ex-Peng G6 anyway. You seen those beasts? Managed to go 0-100 in about 2 seconds; the official site downplays the numbers plus they offer 7+ year warranty on the battery etc so there's no real risks.
[John Doh] @donman92: True, EVs are a different beasts. Great value especially if you have solar at home.
[PerthectDeal] @John Doh: 100%
over 3 years and I have used free excess solar 99% of the time. I use to pay $60 evey 2 weeks on fuel (that would be closer to $100 now)..
[PVA] Is there still such a long wait? Our local toyota dealer has the same rav4 sitting in their yards for weeks before i see tjem gone (i walk our dog past it every day)
[John Doh] @PVA: Maybe its reduced now due to more stocks getting secured - https://www.carsales.com.au/editorial/details/slashed-rav4-w…
The reason you see one standing is probably because no one wants that colour/configuration.
[Dunks] Lol check the sales.. Toyota still on top
[Big L] By a long way too. Although Australia are now buying more cars from China than Japan. Mazda, Subaru and Nissan are plummeting.
[Bimbobob] Tbh neither the Corolla nor Yaris are in the top 25 sold car club. Fleet sales have preferred the Rav now for years.
[neonlight] Toyota is dead. BYD will take rover very soon
[dontpanic] BYD going in for the kill with these price cuts.
[mskeggs] I think this if it is your main car, but under $20k atto is the perfect second car.
Put the $9k saving towards the mortgage.
[Terry25] Hold, will drop another 5k in couple months.
[Terry25] the Chinese brands are competing each other. their strategy is always "kill the Opponent "
Slashing prices just to squeeze out the competition
[Pacify] There's no way. There's not another 5k to squeeze at the price
[Terry25] this car is selling between 17k-20k in China.
100% they can bring this down to kill other brand.
[Save 50 Cent] You forgot about our high import tax, shipping and on-road costs. I mean yeah they might sell at a loss if they wanted to but that strategy usually works for cheap consumables when they first launch not cars.
[SpendMoreNow] @Save 50 Cent: There is zero import tax on chinese ev imports. For other cars it is only 5%. Australia has no local auto or ev industry to protect.
[Save 50 Cent] @SpendMoreNow: Oh didn’t expect that from our government.. that is nice.. but i’m sure they will be some kind of fee like port fee or whatever..
Also local transport cost and dealer overheads are much more in Australia than China.
[Big L] @Save 50 Cent: You're just making things up for your argument.
[Kanjus] @Big L: To be fair, there are a lot of extra costs involved in the import… switching to rhd, extra safety equipment, freight & quarantine.
[Headless] @Save 50 Cent: Don't forget the high Australian profit margins
[Bedgrub] If you wilfully ignore the import and duties, Australia is still a premium market, so you can still make a profit.
[Bid Sniper] BYD is doing a price war with BYD.
Amazing value.
[abuseyourdna] In China, BYD, GEELY, LEAPMOTOR all these brands are very competitive in pricing.
Not just this car, MGS6 EV demo is around $40K (77kwh nmc battery), IM6 demo is $50kish (75kwh)
These are all crazy price if looked at the car. It's just the start.
[jackwangxp] Those cars are NOT the same. Any car/motorbike selling here have to abey ADR. What we get here are much much better as for minimum qualify.
So no, not gonna get much cheaper at 20k or 28k respectively.
[BlueJay87] Geely group outsold byd last month. Ex2 launch has been quite successful.
[Speedz] Geely is a force to reckon with, they own sub brands like Polestar, Volvo, Zeekr and Lotus.
[ProlapsedHeinous] OMG i hope BYD wins, i hate BYD with a passion
[Devolution00] That's what I thought too. Scroll down. The Premium is 7, Essential is 12.
[peter05] you can't actually read any of those marketing headline items in conjunction with each other. usually you'll only be able to pick one or two items from the list they give you.
ie if you want the high acceleration, it won't be the lowest price and it won't have the high km
if you pick the high km, you won't get the small acceleration times.
its a bit of a scam, you have to check the spec sheets closely to look at how the numbers change as you go through the different trim options
[Pacify] Almost as if its a city commuter car, not a drag racer. 0-100km is so utterly irrelevant for the use case
[incipient] That is still a good metric for petrol cars as we know their speed curve better intuitively - for EVs, I feel a more important number would be 0-50 or something - that's really the important range, and for a EV I would bet it's 'less bad' than 0-100 in 12s implies.
But this thing is still no speedster for sure.
[Timm] It's a $20k car, are you expecting sports car performance?
[Devolution00] No, just pointing out it's painfully slow. Fact.
[Devolution00] Why are people so senstive about me calling out a spec which is factual. It's a spec the manufacturer called out. They didn't call out 0-50. 12 secs is as good as a 1982 Honda City 1231cc.
[Blitzfx] You added your opinion on the end, calling it slow when that is and irrelevant to those who downvoted you.
Maybe spend a minute thinking about how your comment may be perceived vs you claiming to make facts-only statements.
[Big L] It's a slug, relatively speaking.
How do you know why everyone that negged did so? It seems like you're adding your opinion at the end and have no fact at the beginning.
[Devolution00] 12 seconds to 100 km/h is objectively slow by modern standards. If calling a 12-second car a slug hurt your feelings, you're driving a slow car, not reading a wrong comment.
[Big L] I have no idea why all the negs for that enlightening fact.
I'm a fan of EVs in general, but that's pathetic no matter the price. Lot's of people don't care, and good for them, but that's a 1965 Corolla figure.
[Gary Gary Gary] Put your payid up - you never know your luck. Pay it forward on OzBargain might become a thing.
[jecec] I also need a car, and i'm inclined to put mine up as an experiment as well.
[topherboi] Why don't we just start a GoFundMe for them instead?
[Covid19] How do people rate this against the Jaecoo j5 ev?
I test drove the Jaecoo on the weekend and it was pretty impressive for a 35k car.
[whichwhatwho] The Dolphin has been out for five years already, in international markets. It's definitely a previous-gen EV, when it comes to everything. The Jaecoo will be the better car but it attracts a higher price for it.
[LanceVance] I know its stupid but I can't get past the name.
[ProlapsedHeinous] Just add a des as the end and pretend its a Japanese person saying Jake
[shxhshzhz] Jaecoo is a 37k SUV. This is a hatchback that is $8000 cheaper. Not comparable.
[Gorby] No, this car will rust slower and then the Tesla will commence rusting
[botchie] @Gorby: Tesla will catch on fire before byd rusts
[The Hobo] Wasn't aware BYDs were rusting? Wasn't it another Chinese brand? Lvd or something?
[willyroo] Look up LDV T60 Statutory Refunds. They pretty much came out of the factory rusting…
[Creamsoda] You mean that one Atto3 example many years back from a car wrecker?
I guess it holds up better than a Hyundai ?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ADeB0fIPlw8
[acersaurus] Isn't the mg4 urban $29990 so effectively $1100 more? And it's got a lot more power, features, leg room and boot room than this slug.
[Headless] Interior build though and unfinished software
[montorola] This sorta looks like a Honda Jazz, would it be as roomy?
[Jaduqimon] Will be only BYDs and ford rangers on the roads in 10 uears time.
[ATangk] Keeping the tow trucks in business with the rangers I see.
[whichwhatwho] Surely clearing way for next model or just consolidating into the Atto <Integer> range
[Bimbobob] Ranger deliveries took a 50% hit in the month of August, still early days. Probs why they've now released the V6 in pov spec trim at ~$60k. Still has halogen bulbs for headlights… Lol
